answer_1.quote: We formulate document-level EAE in the manner of: given a document x = {w 1 , w 2 , ..., w |x| }, it contains a set of described events E. ... The task aims to extract all (a, r) pairs for each e ∈ E, where a ∈ x is an argument-a text span in x and r ∈ R t is the role that a takes.
answer_1.outputs: role records (a sequence of (a, r) pairs)

answer_2.quote: Our results are reported as F-1 score of argument identification (Arg-I) and argument classification (Arg-C). For WikiEvents dataset, we follow  to additionally evaluate argument head F1 score (Head-C).
